channel.title: HY Apps guides
channel.description: Guides for calm iPhone games and apps by HY Apps.

item.title: Queens Puzzle Strategy: 6 Techniques to Solve Any Board
item.description: Six logical techniques that solve every Queens puzzle without guessing, from a bird's reach to group squeezes.

item.title: How to Play Queens: Rules of the Queens Logic Puzzle
item.description: The rules of the Queens puzzle (also known as Star Battle) explained simply: one bird per row, column and color, and birds never touch.

item.title: LinkedIn Queens Alternative: Play Queens Every Day on iPhone
item.description: Love the LinkedIn Queens game? Birbdoku is a free iPhone and iPad game with the same rules, a new daily puzzle, a long level path and hints that explain the logic, played with two cockatiels.

item.title: Games Like Sudoku: Queens and 5 Other Logic Puzzles Worth Trying
item.description: Finished your sudoku? Six logic puzzles with the same pure-deduction feel: Queens, nonograms, kakuro, killer sudoku, futoshiki and tents, with the rules of each.

item.title: Daily Queens Puzzle: Play Today's Birbdoku Bird Puzzle Online
item.description: Play today's Queens logic puzzle free in your browser: one bird in every row, column and color, and birds never touch. A new board every day at 07:00 UTC, the same one as the daily puzzle in the Birbdoku app.

item.title: Daily Puzzle Games Like Wordle: 6 to Play Every Morning
item.description: Loved Wordle? Six daily puzzles with one new board a day, from word games to logic grids like Queens, and where to play them on iPhone.

item.title: A Daily Brain Teaser: The 5-Minute Logic Puzzle Habit
item.description: Why a short daily logic puzzle is a good brain teaser habit, how Queens-style puzzles work your reasoning, and how to build the habit with a streak.

item.title: Cockatiel Game for iPhone: Birbdoku, a Cozy Puzzle With Two Cockatiels
item.description: Looking for a cockatiel game? Birbdoku is a cozy logic puzzle for iPhone and iPad starring two cockatiels, Pika and Chiko, with a garden that grows every day you play.

item.title: Bird Games for iPhone: 5 Picks for Bird Lovers
item.description: Five bird games and apps for iPhone and iPad, from a cozy cockatiel puzzle to a bird board game and a real bird identifier, with what each one is like.

item.title: Restoration Games for iPhone: Rebuild a Ruined Town One Brick at a Time
item.description: Restoration games are about bringing something neglected back to life, step by step, and seeing the result. In Brickhaven you restore a ruined seaside town: lay every brick of nine buildings by hand and each finished one brings its owner home. Offline, no timers.

item.title: Games to Play on a Plane Without Internet: An iPhone and iPad Checklist
item.description: The best games for a flight are ones that need no internet, no account check and no timers. Download and open them at home, restore purchases before you leave, and switch on Low Power Mode on board. Brickhaven, a cozy brick building game, plays fully offline on iPhone and iPad.

item.title: Brickhaven FAQ: Price, Ads, iPad, iCloud, Languages and the Winter Season
item.description: Brickhaven is a cozy first-person brick building game for iPhone and iPad. The first two buildings are free, the rest of the town is a one-time purchase that removes the ads, with no timers or subscriptions. It plays fully offline and keeps your town in your own iCloud.

item.title: A Cozy Winter Game for iPhone and iPad: Snow Season in Brickhaven
item.description: From 1 December to 15 January, Brickhaven's seaside town turns white by itself: snow on the grass, roofs and roads, light strings and wreaths on every finished building, a decorated tree on the square and winter decorations to place. It is a calm, offline building game with no timers.

item.title: An offline pyramid building game for iPhone
item.description: Pyramid Craft lets you build the pyramids of ancient Egypt yourself: dig Nile mud, mould and dry bricks, carry them up and lay three monuments layer by layer. Fully offline.

item.title: How were the pyramids built? Bricks, ramps and workers
item.description: What we know about how the Egyptians built their pyramids: mud brick and stone, ramps, sledges, the Nile and the paid workers who did it, and how Pyramid Craft turns it into a game.

item.title: Pyramid Craft beginner's guide: 10 tips
item.description: Ten tips for your first hour in Pyramid Craft: from the first mud brick to ramps, stores, workers and water wheels.

item.title: Idle Games Without Forced Ads: What to Look For on iPhone
item.description: How to tell an idle game that respects you from one built around ads: rewarded vs forced ads, offline earnings, purchases and timers, with examples.

item.title: Idle Brick Breaker Games: How They Work and a Calm One to Try on iPhone
item.description: What an idle brick breaker is, why it is so relaxing, how upgrades and merging work, and how Glowfly turns the genre into a quiet night-sky story.

item.title: Idle Breakout Alternative for iPhone: A Calm Idle Brick Breaker With a Story
item.description: Loved Idle Breakout? Glowfly is an idle brick breaker for iPhone and iPad: lights bounce and break glass walls on their own, merge into brighter ones and keep playing while you're away.

item.title: Townscaper Alternative: A Cozy Town Builder With a Story (iPhone and iPad)
item.description: Love building pretty seaside towns in Townscaper but want goals and a story? Brickhaven lets you rebuild a seaside town brick by brick, then design and decorate your own streets.

item.title: A Brick-Laying Simulator for iPhone: How Building Works in Brickhaven
item.description: Want to build walls brick by brick on your phone? How Brickhaven's bricklaying works: shapes and colors, blueprints, sections, mortar, the lift and skills.

item.title: Looking for Brick by Brick on iPhone? A Cozy Brick-Building Game for Mobile
item.description: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town is a PC game. If you want the same carry-and-lay brick building on iPhone or iPad, Brickhaven plays offline, solo and at your own pace.

item.title: Best Cozy Building Games for iPhone and iPad (No Timers, Little Stress)
item.description: Five relaxing building games for iPhone and iPad compared: what you build, how you play, whether it works offline and how you pay.

item.title: An Ad-Free Muslim Pro Alternative: Prayer Times, Qur'an and Qibla
item.description: Looking for a simpler, ad-free alternative to Muslim Pro? Bismillah has prayer times with adhan, the Qur'an with audio, a Qibla compass and a missed prayer tracker, and calculates times on your phone.

item.title: Choosing a Prayer Times App: 7 Things to Check
item.description: What makes a prayer times app trustworthy: calculation method, Asr setting, notifications, privacy, ads, Qibla and offline use. A practical checklist.

item.title: Brickhaven Skill Tree: Which Skills to Unlock First
item.description: Every skill in Brickhaven explained: Strong Arms, Skilled Hands, the Brick Magnet, the lift and the rest, with a sensible order to spend your points.

item.title: Design Your Own House: The Architect's Table in Brickhaven
item.description: Draw your own house, shop, café or farm on iPhone and iPad, pick the colors and windows, then build it by hand on your own lot.

item.title: All 9 Buildings in Brickhaven: Owners, Order and What Makes Each One Special
item.description: The nine story buildings of Brickhaven in order, from Martha's Bakery to the Train Station: who lives there, what is new in each and which ones are free.

item.title: 99 Short Qur'an Verses in Arabic with English Meaning
item.description: 99 short verses of the Qur'an with their Arabic text, English meaning and surah reference: verses on patience, gratitude, hope and peace of heart.

item.title: 99 Short Hadiths with English Meaning and Source
item.description: 99 short hadiths with their English meaning and source, on good character, intention, mercy, patience and kindness. Easy to memorize and share.

item.title: 99 Short Duas in Arabic with English Meaning
item.description: 99 short duas (supplications) from the Qur'an and the Sunnah, each with its Arabic text, English meaning and source. Easy to memorize and read every day.

item.title: A Relaxing Idle Merge Game for iPhone That Plays While You're Away
item.description: Looking for a calm idle game with no forced ads? In Glowfly, lights bounce through the dark, merge into brighter ones and reveal a hand-drawn night sky, even while the game is closed.

item.title: How Offline Progress Works in Idle Games (and How to Get the Most From It)
item.description: Idle games keep earning while they're closed. Here is how offline progress is usually calculated, why it has a time limit, and simple habits that make every return worth it, with Glowfly as the example.

item.title: Glowfly Beginner's Guide: 10 Tips to Light Up More Nights
item.description: Ten tips for new players: when to add lights and when to level them, how merging works, which boosts to use before bed and how to break the big rocks faster.

item.title: Reaction Time Test: How Fast Are Your Reflexes?
item.description: Test your reaction time right here: tap when the box turns green. What is a normal reaction time, why it changes and how to get faster.

item.title: Group Games for Game Night: 7 Mind Games for 3 to 12 Players
item.description: Seven group games where your score depends on what everyone else picks: majority, minority, two thirds of the average and more. Rules and tactics.

item.title: Games to Play with Friends on One Phone
item.description: How pass-and-play party games work on one iPhone, which kinds of games suit them best, and how to run a great game night with up to 8 players.

item.title: A Cozy Offline Building Game for iPhone and iPad
item.description: Looking for a relaxing game with no timers and no internet needed? Brickhaven lets you rebuild a seaside town one brick at a time.

item.title: Brickhaven Beginner's Guide: 8 Tips to Build Faster
item.description: Eight tips for new builders: reading the blueprint, carrying more bricks, which skills to pick first and designing your own house.
